description: Bring a touch of festive magic to your bedroom with the Christmas Ornaments duvet cover set. Adorned with a nostalgic print in a cheerfully modern palette, this reversible design captures the little details that make Christmastime special. 52% recycled polyester, 48% BCI cotton. Single includes 1 pillowcase, double, king size, and super king include 2 pillowcases. Popper fastening. Machine washable.
